Description.SourceString: This was the first settlement in Fellhollow. The humans that fled Bramblemead and its cruelty set up the first tents, cabins and early homes here. They would farm, forage and do their best to survive, until gentle Imaru and Xikotal took them in and brought them to Emberwood, where they might found a stronger settlement.
